visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a low-angle tracking shot of a person's lower legs and feet walking forward on a light-grey tiled floor. The person wears white high-heeled sandals and a long, flowing white dress. A green logo with a bird-like emblem and the text 'JUNGLIA OKINAWA' fades in over the center of the frame. (2) A close-up shot follows, showing a young woman with long, dark hair and gold earrings smiling joyfully and looking out toward a scenic view. The background is a bright, clear blue sky with soft white clouds. (3) The camera cuts to a wide, breathtaking panoramic view of a lush, green tropical valley in Okinawa. Dense forests cover dramatic cliffs under a bright sun. Orange and yellow flowers are visible in the foreground on a rocky ledge. (4) A tall CGI Brachiosaurus neck stretches upward into the sky. A young girl with her hair in braids is shown in a close-up, her mouth wide open in a scream of amazement as she looks up at the massive creature. (5) Two people are seen jumping with their arms outstretched into a deep, narrow canyon filled with greenery, captured from a high-angle POV shot. The lighting is bright and natural, casting deep shadows. (6) A giant T-Rex with a wide-open mouth chases a green safari jeep through a thick forest. A woman inside the vehicle is seen screaming while holding onto the roll cage. (7) A unique, colourful bird with a red beak stands on a rock. The scene then shifts to a woman relaxing in an infinity pool that overlooks the expansive jungle landscape during a clear day. (8) At night, vibrant fireworks explode over a theme park setting. A young girl looks up at the sky in wonder. The lighting is low with colorful flashes from the fireworks. (9) A group of three women are sitting at a circular wooden table in a high-altitude platform designed to look like a bird's nest, enjoying food and drinks with a vast forest background. (10) A green off-road vehicle drives through a dusty jungle road. The final scene is a composite graphic showing the 'JUNGLIA OKINAWA' logo, the opening date '7.25', and a CGI layout of the park with balloons and dinosaurs.

editing_and_production_style.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a resonant male voice announcing 'Junglia'. A grand, cinematic orchestral piece immediately swells with a fast BPM and tribal percussion beats. (2) A professional male narrator speaks in Japanese with high energy and clarity. A subtle whoosh SFX occurs as the scene transitions to the valley view. (3) A deep, textured roar of a large dinosaur is heard, followed quickly by the high-pitched scream of a child, which creates a sense of high-arousal excitement. (4) The rumble of a vehicle engine and tires on dirt is audible, overlaid with another female scream as the T-Rex chase occurs. The BGM maintains a driving, rhythmic pulse. (5) A sharp bird chirping SFX punctuates the mix. The music shifts slightly to include airy, atmospheric synthesizers as a woman relaxes in a pool. (6) Several loud, percussive bangs represent firework explosions, accompanied by background cheers and laughs from a crowd. (7) A multi-layered choir chants 'Junglia' in a triumphant harmonic style. The male narrator returns to deliver the closing date with strong command and positive valence. (8) The audio track concludes with a final orchestral flourish and a light chime sound, leaving a clean, professional fade-out.
